arxiv-1608-06212.title: Datatype defining rewrite systems for naturals and integers
arxiv-1608-06212.creator: Jan A. Bergstra, Alban Ponse
arxiv-1608-06212.description: Abstract . A datatype defining rewrite system (DDRS) is an algebraic (equational) specification intended to specify a datatype. When interpreting the equations from left-to-right, a DDRS defines a term rewriting system that must be ground-complete. First we define two DDRSs for the ring of integers, each comprising twelve rewrite rules, and prove their ground-completeness.

arxiv-2107-00831.title: Simulations of Compton Sequencing with the GRETINA Detector
arxiv-2107-00831.creator: Dr. Robert Crabbs, Dr. I-Yang Lee, Dr. Kai Vetter
arxiv-2107-00831.description: Abstract GRETA, the G amma- R ay E nergy T racking A rray, is an array of highly-segmented HPGe detectors designed to track γ \gamma -rays emitted in beam-physics experiments. Its high detection efficiency and state-of-the-art position resolution enable it to reject Compton background and also sequence detected interactions via Compton kinematics.

arxiv-2210-16956.title: Reward Shaping Using Convolutional Neural Network Journal: Information Sciences
arxiv-2210-16956.creator: Hani Sami, Hadi Otrok, Jamal Bentahar, Azzam Mourad, Ernesto Damiani
arxiv-2210-16956.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose Value Iteration Network for Reward Shaping (VIN-RS), a potential-based reward shaping mechanism using Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). The proposed VIN-RS embeds a CNN trained on computed labels using the message passing mechanism of the Hidden Markov Model. The CNN processes images or graphs of the environment to predict the shaping values.

arxiv-2308-15775.title: On the cigar CFT and Schwarzschild horizons
arxiv-2308-15775.description: Abstract Aspects of shock waves and instantly-created folded strings operators in the supersymmetric S ​ L ​ ( 2 ) k / U ⁡ ( 1 ) SL(2)_{k}/U(1) CFT, and their relevance to the near-horizon physics of Schwarzschild black holes in perurbative superstring theory, are presented.

arxiv-2405-03424.title: Cohomological localization for Hamiltonian S 1 S^{1} -actions and symmetries of complete intersections
arxiv-2405-03424.creator: Nicholas Lindsay
arxiv-2405-03424.description: Abstract To begin the paper we revisit a cohomological localization result of Jones-Rawnsley which was subsequently improved by Farber, further generalizing the result. We then proceed to improve a previous result of the author on complete intersections of dimension 8 ​ k 8k with a Hamiltonian S 1 S^{1} -action in two directions.

arxiv-2503-14377.title: Advancing Medical Representation Learning Through High-Quality Data
arxiv-2503-14377.creator: Negin Baghbanzadeh 1,2 *, Adibvafa Fallahpour 2,3,5 *, Yasaman Parhizkar 1,2 *, Franklin Ogidi 2, Shuvendu Roy 2,4, Sajad Ashkezari 1,2, Vahid Reza Khazaie 2, Michael Colacci 3, Ali Etemad 4, Arash Afkanpour 2 † \dagger, Elham Dolatabadi 1,2 † \dagger
arxiv-2503-14377.description: Abstract Despite the growing scale of medical Vision-Language datasets, the impact of dataset quality on model performance remains under-explored. We introduce Open-PMC , a high-quality medical dataset from PubMed Central, containing 2.2 million image-text pairs, enriched with image modality annotations, subfigures, and summarized in-text references.

arxiv-2506-08294.title: Z3Guide : A Scalable, Student-Centered, and Extensible Educational Environment for Logic Modeling CCS: Applied computing Interactive learning environments CCS: Applied computing Computer-assisted instruction CCS: Human-centered computing User centered design
arxiv-2506-08294.creator: Ruanqianqian (Lisa) Huang, Ayana Monroe, Peli de Halleux, Sorin Lerner, Nikolaj Bjørner
arxiv-2506-08294.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ruanqianqian (Lisa) Huang, Ayana Monroe, Peli de Halleux, Sorin Lerner, Nikolaj Bjørner. Constraint-satisfaction problems (CSPs) are ubiquitous, ranging from budgeting for grocery shopping to verifying software behavior. Logic modeling helps solve CSPs programmatically using SMT solvers. Despite its importance in many Computer Science disciplines, resources for teaching and learning logic modeling are scarce and scattered, and challenges remain in designing educational environments for logic modeling that are accessible and meet the needs of teachers and students.

arxiv-2512-18083.title: Causal Inference as Distribution Adaptation: Optimizing ATE Risk under Propensity Uncertainty
arxiv-2512-18083.creator: Ashley Zhang
arxiv-2512-18083.description: Abstract Standard approaches to causal inference, such as Outcome Regression and Inverse Probability Weighted Regression Adjustment (IPWRA), are typically derived through the lens of missing data imputation and identification theory. In this work, we unify these methods from a Machine Learning perspective, reframing ATE estimation as a domain adaptation problem under distribution shift .

pmc-11713972.title: Perfusion and cerebrovascular reactivity characterization in Alzheimer’s disease and vascular dementia
pmc-11713972.creator: Elizabeth G. Keeling, Molly M. McElvogue, Lauren R. Ott, Anna D. Burke, Marwan N. Sabbagh, Nadine Bakkar, Ashley M. Stokes
pmc-11713972.description: BackgroundCerebrovascular changes are often reported in normal aging, Alzheimer’s disease (AD), and vascular dementia (VaD). Cerebral perfusion and cerebrovascular reactivity (CVR) both decrease with dementia compared to healthy aging; as these changes occur prior to symptomatic onset and in distinct brain regions, perfusion and CVR may act as complementary biomarkers of early cerebrovascular changes.

pmc-12455378.title: Physician Peer Influence on Salpingectomy Uptake for Tubal Sterilization and Ovarian Cancer Prevention
pmc-12455378.creator: Xiao Xu, Jessica B. Long, Craig Evan Pollack, Vrunda B. Desai, Cary P. Gross, Erica S. Spatz, Jason D. Wright
pmc-12455378.description: This cohort study evaluates how peer influence among physicians is associated with opportunistic salpingectomy in postpartum and interval sterilizations. Introduction Ovarian cancer causes more deaths than most other gynecologic cancer.1 As there is no routine screening, primary prevention is particularly beneficial.

pmc-12491154.title: Skin Cancer: Epidemiology, Screening and Clinical Features of Acral Lentiginous Melanoma (ALM), Melanoma In Situ (MIS), Nodular Melanoma (NM) and Superficial Spreading Melanoma (SSM)
pmc-12491154.creator: Chun-Te Lu, Teng-Li Lin, Arvind Mukundan, Riya Karmakar, Anusha Chandrasekar, Wen-Yen Chang, Hsiang-Chen Wang
pmc-12491154.description: Melanoma, a highly aggressive form of skin cancer, presents considerable challenges in early detection and accurate diagnosis, particularly across its diverse subtypes such as acral lentiginous melanoma (ALM), melanoma in situ (MIS), nodular melanoma (NM), and superficial spreading melanoma (SSM).

pmc-12566519.title: Analysis of the Fiber Residues Unearthed from the Dabuzi Han Tomb in Xi’an, Shaanxi
pmc-12566519.creator: Zhenzhen Ma, Yingpei Zhu, Jing Shao, Xianting Hou, Menghe Cui, Bei Zhang, Jianxi Li, Qixing Xia, Philippe Colomban
pmc-12566519.description: In 2021, archeologists found that a bronze mirror was wrapped with a yellow-green fiber sheet in the Western Han tomb M68 in the Dabuzi Cemetery in Xi’an, China. To ascertain the composition and function, a scanning electronic microscopy–energy dispersive spectrometer (SEM-EDS), Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), and pyrolysis gas chromatography–mass spectrometry (Py-GC/MS) were combined for the morphology and components’ analysis.

pmc-12577467.title: The Frequency and Reclassification of Variants Uncertain Significance in Hereditary Breast and Ovarian Cancer Among Levantine Patients
pmc-12577467.creator: Nada Assaf, Salim Jamil Sharab, Carla Monsef, Nagi S El Saghir
pmc-12577467.description: IntroductionThe evolution of genetic sequencing technologies in Hereditary Breast and Ovarian Cancer (HBOC) from BRCA1/2 analysis to multigene panel sequencing was paralleled with a significant increase in the number of detected variants of uncertain significance (VUS). This trend was found to particularly affect minority populations, such as the underrepresented Middle Eastern population.

pmc-12615282.title: Quality of life among patients with epilepsy in the western region of KSA: A cross-sectional study
pmc-12615282.creator: Bayan M Almarwani, Manar J Alahmadi, Shouq T Alharbi, Meaad A Alrehaili, Maydaa M Dabi, Rim K Benthami, Samaher N Alsaeedi
pmc-12615282.description: BackgroundAlthough epilepsy can be managed, it markedly affects individuals’ quality of life (QOL), through factors such as seizure severity and social stigma. This study examined QOL in patients with epilepsy living in the western region of KSA.MethodsA cross-sectional design considering clinical and sociodemographic factors was used to assess QOL in patients with epilepsy.

pmc-12634935.title: Preliminary screening of pomegranate-derived compounds for antimicrobial and anti-virulence effects against cariogenic streptococci
pmc-12634935.creator: Nurhayati Mohamad Zain, Indah Mohd Amin, Fathilah Abdul Razak, Mohamed Ibrahim Abu Hassan
pmc-12634935.description: As a biofilm-mediated disease, dental caries is primarily attributed to the activity of Streptococcus mutans and Streptococcus sobrinus, key contributors to enamel mineral loss under acidic conditions. Current broad-spectrum antimicrobials disrupt the oral microbiota and carry undesirable side effects, prompting interest in targeted, microbiome-friendly alternatives.

pmc-13061167.title: Diagnostic performance of four hepatitis-B surface antigen conformité Européenne (CE) marked and one WHO prequalified rapid diagnostic tests in Uganda
pmc-13061167.creator: Leah Naluwagga Baliruno, Charles Drago Kato, Harriet Nakigozi, Huzaima Mujuzi, Emmanuel Seremba, Seth Domfeh, Seth Domfeh, Seth Domfeh, Seth Domfeh, Seth Domfeh
pmc-13061167.description: BackgroundGlobally, over 254 million people are infected with chronic Hepatitis B (HBV). Eighty million of these reside in sub-Saharan Africa (SSA). HBV claims an estimated one million lives annually. Efforts to eradicate it from SSA have been slow, partly due to a lack of affordable, accurate screening tools.

pmc-13264580.title: Incidence of idiopathic intracranial hypertension (IIH) in adults and children: a 14-year population-based study
pmc-13264580.creator: Mina Botrous, Sujan Surendran, Alex Sarossy, Blake D. Colman, Paul G. Sanfillippo, Yong Lin Wang, Shivanand Sheth, Subahari Raviskanthan, David Darby, Clare L. Fraser, Marc Sarossy, Steve Simpson-Yap, Anneke van der Walt

pmc-13276136.title: Response to progestin-based therapy in endometrial intraepithelial neoplasia: An exploratory biomarker study
pmc-13276136.creator: Kieran Seay, Maia Hare, Jin Cao, Arielle Katcher, Meredith Akerman, Semir Beyaz, Gary L. Goldberg, Marina Frimer
pmc-13276136.description: ObjectiveWith the incidence of endometrial intraepithelial neoplasia (EIN) rising among premenopausal women, fertility-sparing management with progestin-based therapy is increasingly utilized, yet a substantial proportion of patients fail to respond. This study explored associations between baseline tissue biomarker expression and response to progestin-based therapy in premenopausal women with EIN.

pmc-13315143.title: Real‐World Usage of a Paclitaxel‐Coated Balloon With Urea Compared With Other Contemporary Drug‐Coated Balloons: A 2‐Year Analysis From SCAAR in Over 6000 Patients
pmc-13315143.creator: Sacharias von Koch, Erika Frank, Katja Gabrysch, Stefan James, Matthias Götberg, Moman A Mohammad, David Erlinge
pmc-13315143.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundDrug‐coated balloons (DCB) are frequently used during percutaneous coronary intervention. Despite this there are limited data from studies comparing different types of DCB, particularly for a paclitaxel‐coated balloon (PCB) using urea as the excipient. This study aimed to assess the clinical efficacy of the PCB with urea compared with other frequently used DCB, attempting to emulate a target trial using observational data.MethodsSCAAR (Swedish Coronary Angiography and Angioplasty Registry) is a nationwide registry including data on all patients in Sweden undergoing coronary angiography.

pmc-13385177.title: Evaluation of the GenoScreen Deeplex Myc-TB workflow for drug-resistant tuberculosis testing in South Africa
pmc-13385177.creator: Jennifer Williams, Janré Steyn, Melanie Grobbelaar, Fahd Naufal, Yonas Ghebrekristos, Nabila Ismail, Jason Limberis, Christoffel Opperman, Sarishna Singh, Rouxjeane Venter, Brendon C. Mann, Felicia B. Hunter, Alina Nalyvayko, Grant Theron, Robin M. Warren, John Z. Metcalfe
pmc-13385177.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Tuberculosis (TB) remains a leading cause of death globally, particularly in low- and middle-income countries, where healthcare systems are under-resourced and the burden of drug-resistant disease is highest. We assessed the feasibility of future integration of the GenoScreen Deeplex Myc-TB assay - a targeted next-generation sequencing (tNGS) assay for Mycobacterium tuberculosis detection and drug-resistance profiling within a national reference laboratory in South Africa.

pmc-13407633.title: Prestin as a potential biomarker for cochlear injury: Current evidence and future directions
pmc-13407633.creator: Nienke Streefkerk, Regina Timmer, Alice I. E. Larsson, Kim E. de Jager, Alexander E. Hoetink, Wilbert P. Vermeij, Alwin D. R. Huitema, Martine van Grotel, Marry M. van den Heuvel-Eibrink
pmc-13407633.description: PurposePrestin has been identified as a potential biomarker for cochlear damage and consequent ototoxicity. Although several preclinical and clinical studies have investigated prestin, a comprehensive overview of the evidence regarding its diagnostic value across different types of auditory damage and its use for cancer treatment-related ototoxicity is currently lacking.

pmc-13620063.title: The BmCPV-derived viral small peptide vsp1S4(-) suppresses viral replication by triggering apoptosis via the ROS-JNK signalling pathway
pmc-13620063.creator: Xialing Chen, Xiaoyan Du, Lixuan Li, Yao Yao, Qian Teng, Haoni Xue, Min Zhu, Xing Zhang, Chengliang Gong, Xiaolong Hu
pmc-13620063.description: Viral antisense RNAs are generally considered noncoding. Here, we show that segment 4 of Bombyx mori cypovirus (BmCPV) encodes a 78-aa antisense-microprotein, vsp1S4(-), that triggers a host-restrictive reactive oxygen species (ROS)-c-Jun N-terminal kinase (JNK)-apoptosis axis. vsp1S4(-) localizes to mitochondria, induces superoxide release, and activates JNK signalling.

pmc-13671155.title: Excellent 2‐Year Outcomes of MUIB All‐Inside ACL Reconstruction: A Registry‐Based Analysis of 63 Patients With Zero Graft Failure
pmc-13671155.creator: Badrul Akmal Hisham Md Yusoff, Mohamad Helmi Bin Hamid, Norlelawati Mohamad, Karbela Reza Ramlan, Nik Kamarul Arif Nik Kamaruzman, Aliff Omar, Zhafir Asikin, M. Azwan Aziz
pmc-13671155.description: BackgroundAnterior cruciate ligament reconstruction (ACLR) remains a cornerstone of orthopedic sports medicine, yet graft failure rates are high despite advances in surgical techniques. The Modified UKM Internal Bracing (MUIB) technique combines all‐inside ACLR with internal suture augmentation, potentially offering enhanced graft protection and improved outcomes.
